verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents traceability: you can open the Model and check every number, outputs print their lineage back to the source line, and Actuals come in from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Rillet. Its forecasting covers revenue, costs, and cash, but the docs never name P&L, balance sheet, or cash flow statement views. Missing for 10: explicit P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement views; documented click-through drill-down from a statement figure to individual ledger transactions; independent or hands-on corroboration.
